description: This file defines the jjwg_MapsController class, which manages Google Maps integrations within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for geocoding addresses, displaying maps and markers, exporting address data, and configuring map settings. The class interacts with various modules and external services, handles user input, and renders map-related interfaces.

classes.name: jjwg_MapsController
classes.description: Controller class managing Google Maps operations, geocoding, map display, and configuration within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, loads configuration settings.

methods.name: configuration
methods.description: Loads the map configuration settings from global variables.

methods.name: action_geocoded_counts
methods.description: Computes geocoded address counts per module and response code, for display purposes.

methods.name: action_geocode_addresses
methods.description: Performs geocoding of addresses for specified modules, updating cache and database.

methods.name: defineMapsAddressCustom
methods.description: Placeholder for custom address definition logic; returns input by default.

methods.name: action_add_to_target_list
methods.description: Adds selected records to a target prospect list.

methods.name: action_export_geocoding_addresses
methods.description: Exports addresses pending geocoding as a CSV file.

methods.name: action_geocoding_test
methods.description: Provides a test interface for Google geocoding service.

methods.name: action_config
methods.description: Displays and saves map configuration settings from admin interface.

methods.name: action_reset_geocoding
methods.description: Resets geocode information for a specific module.

methods.name: action_delete_all_address_cache
methods.description: Deletes all cached address geocode data.

methods.name: action_quick_radius
methods.description: Prepares data for quick radius map display.

methods.name: action_quick_radius_display
methods.description: Displays the quick radius map.

methods.name: action_map_display
methods.description: Displays the main map interface.

methods.name: action_donate
methods.description: Displays the donation page.

methods.name: action_map_markers
methods.description: Generates map markers for various display modes, such as specific records, lists, or areas.

methods.name: getMarkerData
methods.description: Creates marker data array from a given bean/object, including HTML info window generation.

methods.name: getMarkerDataCustom
methods.description: Creates custom marker data from a marker object.

methods.name: getAreaDataCustom
methods.description: Creates area shape data for map display.

methods.name: is_valid_lng
methods.description: Validates longitude value.

methods.name: is_valid_lat
methods.description: Validates latitude value.
